leadText: Sara Lee (Japanese: シン・リー Cyn Lee) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.
plainText:
Sara Lee (Japanese: シン・リー Cyn Lee) is a minor recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Performer.

==History==
 
Sara Lee first appeared in A Dancing Debut!, where she was seen participating in the Couriway Town Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class. She gained enough audience votes in the Theme Performance to advance to the Freestyle Performance, but ultimately lost to Jessilee.

In Master Class Choices!, Sara Lee competed in the Showcase Rookie Class, but this time, she did not make it past the Theme Performance.

In Master Class Is in Session!, Sara Lee competed in the Pokémon Showcase Master Class in Gloire City. In the first round, she went up against and Miette. Her performance didn't get enough votes from the audience, however, and she ended up being ranked third in the group.

She appeared alongside Concetta in the Poké Problem segment of When Regions Collide!, where they were shown wearing casual clothes and carrying their luggage at an airport in Kanto.
